jobs.description:
Level up!

Nintendo Co., Ltd., headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, has been providing a wide range of entertainment products and experiences since its founding in 1889, beginning with the manufacture and sale of Hanafuda playing cards. Since the 1983 release of the Family Computer (Famicom) system in Japan, and continuing through Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo’s focus has been the development, manufacturing, and sale of its gaming systems and software. 

At Nintendo, we bring together employees with a wide range of characteristics and work together towards a common goal – to put smiles on the faces of people all over the world. 

Tasks

- Supporting the preparation of the German corporate income tax and trade tax returns and taking ownership of the tax compliance process for smaller permanent establishments in UK , Switzerland, and Austria
- Preparing and managing monthly IFRS tax reporting for Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and the UK and reviewing the tax provisions and tax calculations for other foreign permanent establishments and coordinating with local finance teams
- Preparing and submitting German withholding tax filings and related tax compliance obligations
- Supporting domestic and international tax audits, including managing information requests from tax authorities
- Assisting with tax projects, tax technical analyses, and the implementation of tax law changes
- Liaising with external advisors, auditors, and internal stakeholders on tax-related matters
- Contributing to the continuous improvement and standardization of tax processes and controls

Requirements

- University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Taxation, Law, or a comparable field
- Several years of professional experience in corporate taxation, ideally gained with a Big Four accounting firm, a multinational corporation, or a comparable international environment
- Professional experience acquired abroad and exposure to different tax jurisdictions would be considered an advantage
- Strong understanding of international corporate tax law and tax compliance processes
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an international team environment
- High level of commitment, reliability, and ownership
- Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
- Fluent written and spoken English skills
- Strong MS Office skills, particularly Excel
- Experience with SAP is considered a plus
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Are you interested? We look forward to receiving your application in English, including your earliest possible starting date and salary expectation.

That's The Job

- Development and maintenance of our native Android app in Kotlin, from design to Play Store release
- Hands-on experience integrating mobile applications with embedded devices
- Implementation of adaptive user interfaces based on Figma designs
- Contribution to key technical decisions, clean code and code reviews
- Stay updated with the latest Android development trends and technologies
- Close collaboration with the iOS, backend, hardware and QA teams

That's You

- At least 3 years of professional experience in native Android development with Kotlin
- Solid knowledge of Jetpack Compose, Material3, Coroutines/Flow and modern architecture patterns
- Experience in using tools such as Android Studio, Git, Jenkins Pipelines
- Confident in testing (unit) and agile development methods (Scrum)
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude) and critical evaluation of their output
- Advantageous: Kotlin Multiplatform, Firebase, Java, iOS/Swift familiarity
- Strong language skills – German at A1 and English at C1 level in written and spoken. What matters most is confident communication in both languages, in writing and speaking

That's What We Offer

At Flexoptix GmbH, we're more than just a workplace – we're a community dedicated to fostering growth, well-being, and success. When you join our team, you become part of a supportive environment where your contributions are valued, and your potential is nurtured. Here's why you'll love being part of our team:

- An attractive package: In addition to the gratifying salary, we offer a robust company pension plan to help you build a secure financial future and a Company Health Insurance Plan with a coverage that goes beyond the basics, providing you with additional benefits to support your health journey.
- **Access to Top-notch IT and Office Equipment:** Operating system and hardware of your choice, additional tech equipment that you need, screens, you name it — we want to enable you to do your best work.
- **Stay Active and Healthy with our Gym partner:** Maintain your well-being with our health and sports offer.
- **Feeling hungry? We've got you covered!** Fuel your workday with a delicious lunch from our diverse menu selection. Enjoy fresh fruit and cereal anytime you need a snack. Plus, you'll find chocolates in every corner of our office to satisfy your sweet tooth.
- Personal Development: Expand your skills and knowledge through workshops, conferences, language courses, advanced training, and webinars.
- **Convenient Location and Transportation Options:** Our office is conveniently located in the woods and easily accessible by public transport, car, or bicycle, making your commute a breeze and we've got you covered with covered bicycle parking and warm showers available onsite.
- Enjoy 30 days of annual vacation, giving you ample time to relax, recharge, and explore new experiences.
- **Stay Active and Eco-Friendly with Bike Leasing:** Stay active with our bike leasing program, offering a convenient and sportive commuting option.
- **Hybrid/Onsite Working:** We offer flexible hybrid/onsite working arrangements allowing you to work remotely and dedicating three days to onsite
- Discounted Public Transport Tickets: Save money on public transportation with our discounted public transport tickets, making you wanting to travel more.
- **Make an impact!** Work in an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the telecommunication world! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

That's How We Connect

Would you like to find out more about Flexoptix GmbH as an employer? Then take a look at LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/flexoptix-gmbh/) , Kununu (https://www.kununu.com/de/flexoptix) , Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/flexoptix/)  or Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/flexOptix) .

Flexoptix GmbH is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

jobs.occupation: Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D (Leiter/in - Softwareentwicklung)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building high-performing engineering organizations and shaping the future of digital product delivery? Do you enjoy combining strong technical understanding with people leadership, operational excellence, and transformation? 

In KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA Einbeck, we are looking for a  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D to lead and further develop our digital engineering organization. As part of the R&D Digital Product & Technology Development leadership team you will drive the delivery of digital products, platforms, and services for R&D, while continuously improving engineering standards, delivery performance, quality, reliability, and productivity.  

You will play a key role in evolving our engineering setup into a more flexible, AI-enabled, and metric-driven organization that can respond dynamically to changing business priorities and accelerate innovation across KWS. 

Your Responsibilities 

As  Head (m/f/d) of Software Engineering & Architecture in R&D, you will shape the future of digital product delivery at KWS by building a high-performing and adaptable engineering organization that enables innovation on a scale. 

You will: 

- Lead and further develop the engineering organization responsible for delivering digital products, platforms, and services that support our global R&D activities.
- Drive engineering excellence by creating an environment where teams can deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality solutions with speed and impact.
- Build a future-ready organization by advancing modern ways of working, strengthening engineering capabilities, and unlocking the potential of AI across the development lifecycle.
- Foster strong partnerships across business and technology functions while ensuring effective collaboration with external vendors and service partners.
- Inspire, coach, and empower leaders and teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, innovation, and inclusion. 

Your Profile 

You are an experienced technology leader (m/f/d) who enjoys developing people, shaping organizations, and turning ambitious ideas into business value. 

You bring: 

- Proven leadership experience in software engineering, digital product development, or technology-driven organizations.
- A track record successfully leading complex products, platforms, or transformation initiatives in dynamic environments.
- Strong understanding of modern engineering practices and the ability to translate strategic goals into effective execution.
- Experience driving organizational change and building high-performing teams through trust, empowerment, and collaboration.
- Curiosity for emerging technologies, including AI, and a passion for continuously improving how engineering teams work and deliver value.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in English. German is a plus. 

What You Can Expect 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape a strategically important engineering function at the interface of digital technology, R&D, and innovation. You will work in a global environment and contribute to strengthening the digital capabilities that support KWS’ future growth. 

You can expect: 

- A leadership role with global scope and high strategic relevance.  
- The opportunity to shape modern engineering standards, practices, and operating models  
- Highly motivated internal teams of software developers working in synthony with external teams
- A strong support to enable new technologies, like AI, and to develop future-ready digital capabilities
- Close collaboration with digital products, technology, R&D, and business stakeholders
- A working environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation 

Join Us 

If you are excited about leading engineering transformation, enabling high-performing teams, and shaping the future of digital product delivery in an innovative R&D environment, we look forward to receiving your application. 

**Grow your career with KWS and help us build the digital capabilities of tomorrow.**

Nothing provides more motivation than success. Da Vinci Engineering is highly committed to ensuring the own employees' success. Become a part of us!

Your ContributionAs an Application Process Manager, you ensure that applications effectively support business processes throughout their lifecycle. Working at the interface between Business and IT, you translate requirements into functional concepts and support their implementation in close collaboration with stakeholders across the organization. You help drive digitalization, process harmonization, and continuous improvement while ensuring that applications remain aligned with business needs and global standards. In this role, you actively shape change, contribute to rethinking energy, and foster collaboration built on team spirit and mutual respect. Your Mission – what you can expect from us:

- Process Ownership – Taking responsibility for the functional design, continuous improvement, and standardization of application-supported processes in line with business requirements.

- Change Management – Coordinating enhancements and change requests from concept creation through testing, approval, release planning, and implementation.
- Requirements Management – Documenting business requirements and process adaptations in a structured manner and ensuring a smooth handover for technical realization.
- Governance & Improvement – Defining relevant KPIs, supporting key users and training activities, and driving continuous improvement across regions and subsidiaries.
Your Profile – what you bring:
- Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a comparable qualification; alternatively vocational training with relevant professional experience.
- Experience in an interface function between Business and IT, preferably within customer service, logistics, order management, or data management.
- Knowledge of application management and preferably hands-on experience with SAP.

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airbus we are looking for a

Research and Technology Composite Engineer (d/f/m)

An open position for a Composite Engineer has arisen within the Composite Technology team for Central Manufacturing Engineering inside Airbus Aerostructures in Stade. This transnational team is maturing new technologies in R&T in order to secure, improve, and ramp up both legacy and future aircraft programs.

Your location

With its 2,500 employees, the Stade plant is a constantly growing producer of complex CFRP components. All vertical stabilizers for Airbus commercial aircraft, the A400M and various individual parts from the Airbus programs come from Stade. Even in times of industrial change, the Stade plant wants to maintain its position as market leader for complex CFRP components for the aviation industry - with a powerful strategy in the areas of processes, products and people. Stade offers you a modern working environment, combined with a high quality of life in the region and proximity to Hamburg.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- To identify the needs from the customer (plants, new programs) and deliver solutions through the set-up of R&T projects in transnational context.
- To support & validate developments with Experts, Industrial and Digital Architects.
- To develop & implement improvements to Composite processes & Technologies.
- To plan and perform physical trials and developments to enable maturation and validation of processes, materials and technologies , including robust data capture and analysis.
- To collaborate with (and manage) partners such as Technological centres or suppliers for new developments

Desired skills and qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree for materials, manufacturing systems or similar
- First experience in managing trials in shopfloor environment, composite manufacturing process and project management
- Fluent English and German skills
- Highly motivated and engaged, very high attitude for working independently and open minded for new developments
- Being creative and passion for working in a transnational technical environment
- Interest to work technically on a product and a process

Airbus Aerostructures is pioneering its digital transformation, and we are seeking a proactive SAP Technical Expert with a strong leadership mindset. You will bridge architectural vision and hands-on execution, ensuring seamless business continuity across our legacy systems while steering operational readiness for our S/4HANA Cloud transition.

Scope: Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technical Solutions, S/4HANA Cloud, and SAP BTP.

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

- Project Management & Service Leadership: Ideate, steer, and deliver complex technical projects to optimize ERP performance and transformations. Drive continuous improvement in partner service delivery and manage connectivity pipelines (REST/SOAP/RFC APIs, SAP Event Mesh) across cross-functional teams.
